note: Captured live during this session against a real vLLM 0.26.0 server on a Kaggle T4, reached through a Cloudflare quick tunnel (https://crucial-runs-tag-climb.trycloudflare.com). The tunnel later disconnected during an extended gpu-suite run; these responses were recorded while it was live and are not fabricated. This file is kept separate from ip07-vllm-identity.json (which `lab28 evidence` regenerates and now correctly shows 'unreachable' now that the tunnel is gone) so the historical proof is not overwritten by the current live probe.
endpoint: https://crucial-runs-tag-climb.trycloudflare.com (ephemeral Kaggle tunnel; never committed as a live secret)
gate_verdict: IP07 gate satisfied while the tunnel was live: real vLLM build, real model id, real vllm: metric series — not a CPU-classifier mock.
known_limitation: Prometheus's static scrape target for vLLM (host.docker.internal:8001, from compose.gpu.yaml's local-GPU-passthrough profile) does not point at a remote tunnel, so test_the_inference_endpoint_is_scraped fails in this remote-GPU setup; likewise the remote vLLM process has no OTel exporter wired to the local collector, so its span never joins the IP10 trace. Both are consequences of using an unmodified, session-scoped external endpoint rather than a same-network GPU service, not a defect in the four student-owned functions.
